create_glrenderer_instance: create a glRenderer instance with custom width, height, and shader program files for OpenGL rendering
set_mesh_vertices_faces: set mesh data by passing numpy arrays of vertices, faces, and optional color to the renderer
add_mesh_to_existing: add additional mesh data to the existing mesh by concatenating new vertices, faces, and colors
display_rendered_scene: display the rendered 3D scene with configurable camera view modes like cam, side, or free
get_screen_color_ibgr: get the rendered screen color as an integer BGR numpy array for image processing or saving
get_z_value_depth: get the depth buffer z-values as a 2D numpy array from the rendered OpenGL scene
set_camera_view_mode: set the camera view mode to cam, side, or free for different 3D visualization perspectives
set_viewpoint_matrices: set custom projection and model-view matrices for precise control over the OpenGL camera viewpoint
set_background_texture: set a background image texture by passing a numpy array to render behind the 3D mesh
clear_mesh_data: clear all mesh vertex, normal, and index data from the renderer to reset the scene
